name: Shendian - THE TEMPLE
source:
The Temple is an interactive visual novel game adapted from the short story of the same name by H. P. Lovecraft.

In the game, you play as Karl Heinrich, the captain of the German Navy submarine U-29. During a submarine battle, you discover a mysterious ivory statue. You are then drawn to the south by a mysterious current, eventually reaching the Temple of the Abyss.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《神庙》是一款互动视觉小说游戏，改编自H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特的同名短篇小说。

在游戏中，你扮演卡尔·海因里希，德国海军潜艇U-29的船长。在一次潜艇战斗中，你发现了一尊神秘的象牙雕像。然后你被一股神秘的水流吸引到南方，最终到达深渊神殿。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877260/]Steam[/url]]
